title: Concept: Flutter package with no Flutter SDK constraint
description: pubspec.yaml declares an `environment` block that names no Flutter version, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads an `environment` block that names no Flutter version.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through pubspec.yaml (pub).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads an `environment` block that names no Flutter version.
